title: A profile file v0
description: A profile the person keeps in the desk folder, ~/.desk/profiles/<id>.yaml: desk.profiles.save writes it and the person may edit it. The file is YAML; this schema describes the data it holds once parsed. The file name is the profile id, so the file holds none. A file of a contributed profile's id shadows that profile.

ProfileFile.description: The whole of a profile file. Every key is optional; an empty file is a profile that changes nothing.

version.description: The format version. Default 0. Desk ignores a file with a version newer than it reads.

name.description: What the profile switcher shows. Default: the file name.

description.description: One line under the name in the switcher.

settings.description: Settings in force while the profile is, over init.yaml's.
